description: Get the authenticated user's posterly subscription: status, tier, cancel-at-period-end, period end, trial end and pause state. Also reports connected accounts in use and the account limit for the workspace this caller is acting in (plan tier plus any extra slots). Call this FIRST for "upgrade", "change plan", "add accounts" or "how many accounts": it returns the plans above this user's with prices, limits and credits, the Agency extra-accounts state (owners), and the exact next steps. Read-only. Requires the billing:read scope.
name: get_subscription
